title: Flat cokernel of a universally exact sequence
statement: Let $0\to M_1\to M_2\to M_3\to0$ be a universally exact sequence of modules over a commutative ring $R$ (that is, tensoring it with every $R$-module remains exact). If $M_2$ is flat over $R$, then $M_3$ is flat over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
